# synology_file_transfer_logging (Resource)

Per-protocol file-transfer logging policy. Log contents, retention and detailed operation filters remain outside this resource. Omitted flags preserve their current values; destroy leaves logging enabled or disabled as configured on DSM.

## Adopt existing settings

Use an initialized project from [Check the NAS connection](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/elephant-evergreen/synology/latest/docs#check-the-nas-connection). Add this import block with your resource address and the ID of the existing DSM object.

```terraform
import {
  to = synology_file_transfer_logging.main
  id = "file_transfer_logging"
}
```

1. Add the resource block with the values DSM currently reports. Use the sample configuration as a starting point.
2. Run `terraform plan -out=adopt.tfplan`. For one import, expect `1 to import, 0 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy`. If the plan proposes changes, match the differing arguments to DSM and save a new plan.
3. Run `terraform apply adopt.tfplan` once the saved plan contains only the import. The next `terraform plan` should report `No changes`.

## Example configuration

```terraform
resource "synology_file_transfer_logging" "main" {
  smb_enabled          = true
  afp_enabled          = false
  ftp_enabled          = false
  tftp_enabled         = false
  webdav_enabled       = false
  file_station_enabled = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `afp_enabled` (Boolean) Record AFP file-transfer activity.
- `file_station_enabled` (Boolean) Record File Station file-transfer activity.
- `ftp_enabled` (Boolean) Record FTP file-transfer activity.
- `smb_enabled` (Boolean) Record SMB file-transfer activity.
- `tftp_enabled` (Boolean) Record TFTP file-transfer activity.
- `webdav_enabled` (Boolean) Record WebDAV file-transfer activity.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Singleton identity and import identifier: file_transfer_logging. Destroy only releases Terraform management; it never resets DSM settings.
